title: Rhythm Heaven — Sequels and legacy
text:
Title: Rhythm Heaven — Sequels and legacy

Rhythm Heaven was succeeded by Rhythm Heaven Fever for the Nintendo Wii in 2011; Nintendo president Satoru Iwata saw potential in the game in people's living rooms. He replied: "When you see others play with the game and notice that he or she misses out on being perfectly in rhythm, it can also be surprisingly fun." Four years later, another Rhythm Heaven game was released for the Nintendo 3DS under the title of Rhythm Heaven Megamix. It features games from the DS installment, as well as rhythm games from Fever and the original Rhythm Tengoku along with brand-new ones. Rhythm Heaven is frequently referenced in the WarioWare and Super Smash Bros. series. In March 2025, Nintendo announced a new Rhythm Heaven game, Rhythm Heaven Groove. The game will release in 2026.
